build_mlp: build a multi-layer perceptron model with configurable input, hidden, output dimensions and layer count
build_mlp_as_module_list: build an MLP as a ModuleList of sequential layers for step-by-step forward passes
soft_update_params: perform a soft parameter update on a target network using a tau interpolation factor
set_seed_everywhere: set a random seed across torch, CUDA, numpy, and Python random for reproducibility
eval_mode: use a context manager to temporarily set PyTorch models to evaluation mode
